definitions.explanation: A scene or view at a particular place, especially one with emotional or atmospheric significance. Used in literary and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{場景|ばけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A beautiful scene spread out before us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{場景|ばけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だった。
examples.english: The opening scene of the novel was memorable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{焼|や}け→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{場景|ばけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The scene of the postwar burnt-out wasteland influenced many writers.

notes:
A somewhat literary or formal word for a scene or setting, composed of ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place) and {景|けい} (scenery, view). More evocative than the everyday word ⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧, emphasizing the visual or atmospheric quality of a scene.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{場景|ばけい} — beautiful scene
- ⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧な{場景|ばけい} — memorable scene
- ⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な{場景|ばけい} — grand spectacle
- {場景|ばけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ — a scene unfolds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧ — scene (more common, used for specific moments in stories or events)
- ⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ — sight, spectacle (emphasizes what is visually witnessed)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧ — landscape, scenery (natural or outdoor views)
